## About
Jeeva Venkidu is an Agricultural Engineer turned Backend Software Developer who builds high-performance digital products, AI orchestration engines, and open-source developer tooling.

## Key Technical Skills
- **Backend Architecture**: Node.js, Express, Laravel 11, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, JWT, Prisma, Docker, TimescaleDB.
- **AI & Systems**: AI Agent skill orchestration, OpenAI SDK, RAG ecosystems, subagent workflows, CLI tooling.
- **Frontend & UI Engineering**: Next.js 16, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, HTML5 Canvas 60 FPS sequence scrubbing.
